title: Rising energy prices put AI and data centers in the crosshairs

author: Tim De Chant

title: AI researchers ’embodied’ an LLM into a robot – and it started channeling Robin Williams
description: AI researchers at Andon Labs embedded various LLMs in a vacuum robot to test how ready they were to be embodied. And hilarity ensued.
author: Julie Bort

title: AI mania tanks CoreWeave’s Core Scientific acquisition — it buys Python notebook Marimo
description: CoreWeave's failed buy of Core Scientific is another sign of an AI bubble. But it's still shopping.
author: Julie Bort

title: Equity Live: From $300M seed rounds to data center builds, AI is feeling bubbly
description: The Equity crew was live at TechCrunch Disrupt 2025! Hosts Kirsten Korosec, Max Zeff, and Anthony Ha took over the Builders Stage on Monday morning to kick off the event with the question everyone’s asking: are we in an AI bubble?  Between valuations that have tripled in months, $300M seed rounds, and $100B commitments flying […]
author: Theresa Loconsolo, Kirsten Korosec, Anthony Ha, Maxwell Zeff

title: AWS exceeds Wall Street’s expectations as demand for cloud infra remains high

author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Perplexity strikes multi-year licensing deal with Getty Images
description: Perplexity’s agreement with Getty appears to legitimize some of the startup’s previous use of Getty’s stock photos. Perplexity came under fire last year for a series of plagiarism accusations from several news organizations.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Tim Cook says Apple is open to M&A on the AI front

title: Reddit CEO says chatbots are not a traffic driver
description: Reddit doesn't see a lot of traffic coming from chatbot answers
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Nvidia expands AI ties with Hyundai, Samsung, SK, Naver
description: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang is visiting South Korea to strengthen partnerships with Samsung, Hyundai, SK, and Naver, unveiling plans for AI-powered networks and next-generation intelligent systems.

title: Figma acquires AI-powered media generation company Weavy
description: Figma said that Weavy will exist as a stand-alone product for now and that, in the future, it will be integrated with the Figma Weave brand, along with the rest of the Figma platform.

title: The Prompting Company snags $6.5M to help products get mentioned in ChatGPT and other AI apps
description: Retailers could see up to a 520% increase in traffic from chatbots and AI prompts in 2025 compared to 2024, according to the report. For brands, that means figuring out how to show up in AI-generated recommendations, and fast.
